function: Cascaded BS-IRS-user channel estimation for IRS-assisted mmWave MIMO-OFDM: refines LS estimates obtained with deactivated IRS elements, to cut pilot overhead (p. 1, 5).
system: TDD IRS-assisted MIMO-OFDM, direct link blocked: 16-antenna ULA BS, 12x12 passive reflecting IRS (144 elements), single-antenna user, 28 GHz (p. 3, 8).
method: Two-stage CNN: axial self-attention network (CAN) recovers deactivated IRS elements, then multi-convolutional denoiser (CMN); supervised MSE training, CAN trained first and frozen (p. 6-7).
data_channel: Synthetic 3GPP TR 38.901 Rel-17 CDL, UMi, 28 GHz, 4 IRS-BS and 10 MU-IRS paths; 80,000 samples: 50,000 train, 20,000 validation, 10,000 test (p. 8-9).
test_conditions: Trained across various SNRs on UMi data and tested on held-out UMi samples; generalization test trains on UMi and tests on UMa without adaptation (p. 9, 11).
baselines: Non-learned LS and SMJCE; learned or hybrid RS-OMP, DD-FS, SRDnNet, DA-RLAMP and SFCNN (p. 9).
metrics: NMSE versus SNR, pilot count B, IRS size and BS antennas; pilot overhead reduction versus LS; average estimation time (p. 9-12).
complexity: Complexity order O(2.5x10^5 Nt M K) approx. for MBA, compared with baselines in Table IV; measured estimation time 41.77 ms at B=48 (p. 8, 12).
q1_support: p. 8: "We adopt the 3GPP TR 38.901 Release 17 CDL model to simulate a mmWave channel in a UMi scenario"; p. 3: "we adopt the clustered delay line (CDL) channel model specified in the 3GPP TR 38.901 standard".
q2_support: p. 11: "trained using channel data generated under the UMi scenario and then tested on the UMa scenario without any adaptation"; Fig. 9 reports the UMi and UMa results.
q3_support: p. 9: "including LS, SMJCE [14], RS-OMP [26], DDFS [27], SRDnNet [28], DA-RLAMP [29], and SFCNN [35]"; p. 11: "outperforming DD-FS by 51%, RS-OMP by 76%, DA-RLAMP by 62%, and SMJCE by 90%" in NMSE. LS and SMJCE are non-learned (p. 1: SMJCE [14] is a structured matrix recovery and CS method).
q4_support: p. 8: "the total computational complexity of the MBA estimator across all K subcarriers is given by" a Big-O expression; p. 12: Table IV lists complexity orders and estimation times, and "measured the average estimation time over 10,000 test samples across all subcarriers".
q5_support: p. 9: "80,000 channel samples were synthesized" with the paper's own CDL generator; no link to code or data, no public dataset and no measured data.
notes: Included, area 2 (cascaded channel estimation with IRS element deactivation to reduce pilots). q1=1: the paper states it adopts the 3GPP TR 38.901 Rel-17 CDL model (UMi), although the delay spread, delays and angular spreads are sampled by the authors following Table 7.5-6 (p. 8-9). q2=1: UMi-trained models tested on UMa without adaptation (p. 11). q3=1: non-learned LS and SMJCE and several learned baselines, all compared on NMSE. q4=1: Big-O expression and Table IV timings. q5=0: synthetic data, no link. Table IV (p. 12) and Figs. 8-9 (p. 11) were checked on the PDF pages.
